One dock brings your devices together for charging, fast data transfer and dual display management.
160W of total output charges up to four devices at once through three USB-C ports at 100W max each and one USB-A port at 12W max.
Manage data across several devices at speeds of up to 10Gbps, with dual 4K display and audio options.

The two HDMI ports mirror or extend your screen across 2 displays at up to 2K@60Hz with a DP 1.4 laptop or 1080p@60Hz with a DP 1.2 laptop. A 5120×1440 monitor is not supported, and on macOS both external monitors show the same image.
Supports USB-C, USB4 and Thunderbolt connections, and works with Windows 10 and 11, ChromeOS and laptops with DP Alt Mode and Power Delivery. It is not compatible with Linux.
Anker Prime Charging Docking Station (14-in-1, Dual Display, 160W), a USB-C cable for the upstream port (3.3 ft, 100W, 10Gbps) and a safety sheet.
